📖 How to use

  1. Press Start, then 🔊 to hear the word.
  2. Read the definition clue.
  3. Type the spelling and press Enter.
  4. Streaks earn bonus points — spell them all!

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I hear the word?

Your browser reads the word aloud with speech synthesis — press the speaker button to hear it again.

Is there a definition clue?

Every word shows its definition as a clue, just like a real spelling bee.

How does scoring work?

Each correct spelling scores 10 points plus a streak bonus; wrong spellings reset the streak.

How many words are there?

60 words from easy to tricky, asked in random order without repeats.
